ambiguities.text: The meta EIP lists EIP-7642 as an optional networking upgrade with 'mandatory implementation by the subsequent upgrade cycle' without specifying what happens if nodes don't implement it.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-7642 is soft-required and nodes without it may have degraded network connectivity but remain functional.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between Prague (EL) and Electra (CL) activation timing is implied but not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Prague and Electra activate at the same slot/block boundary as determined by the activation epoch.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client teams have implemented and tested all 11 core EIPs before the activation epoch.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incomplete implementations could cause consensus failures or network splits at fork activation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The increased complexity from 11 simultaneous EIPs can be safely validated on testnets before mainnet.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Subtle interaction bugs between EIPs could manifest only under mainnet conditions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Security considerations delegated to individual EIPs have been adequately addressed.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Systemic security vulnerabilities could be overlooked when reviewing EIPs in isolation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The new testnet 'Hoodi' provides adequate coverage for testing the combined fork behavior.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hoodi-specific testing may not reveal issues that only appear on Sepolia or mainnet.
